title: The Bone Choir
text: Skulls in niches up and down the barrow walls sing a dirge in a hundred voices, jaws clacking in time. The sound fills the dark like cold water. One niche is empty, and every time the song reaches it, it falters and starts again.

options.label: The steadiest voice sings the missing part, so that the dead may finish their song.

outcomes.text: The song closes over the gap like water. Satisfied, the dead fall silent, and the silence that follows is very deep.

options.label: Put a skull from outside into the empty niche, and give the choir a new voice.

outcomes.text: The song changes key into a battle hymn. The dead rise from their niches to sing it properly.

options.label: Walk on very quietly, and leave the dead to their broken dirge.

outcomes.text: The song follows you for a mile. Each time it reaches the gap it falters, waiting for someone to fill it.
